correctness.rationale: An anchored length-n closed walk on pairs of p-bit time histories enforces the exactly-one rule at every site and time. It determines a unique initial row fixed by F_n^p and conversely is determined by that row. Anchor and orientation are retained, so the trace counts labelled configurations, not rotation/reflection classes. A fresh bitwise reconstruction and Kosaraju decomposition gave the stated cyclic SCCs. The only branching block has 60 vertices, with 12 vertices of outdegree two within the block; all paths to the next such vertex have length five. The nonbranching vertices induce an acyclic graph, so eliminating them by the Schur complement reduces det(I−zA) on that block to the determinant of I minus the weighted branch adjacency with weights z^5 per path. Enumerating all 324 collections of disjoint directed branch cycles (including the empty collection), with sign minus per cycle, gives 1−6z^10+9z^20−4z^30=(1−z^10)^2(1−4z^10). All other cyclic components are simple cycles of lengths [1,2] at heights 1 and 3, [1,2,4] at height 2 and [1,2,4,8,8,8] at height 6. This independently gives both determinant identities, also reconfirmed via exact Newton identities in a separate reconstruction. The formal log derivative extracts all trace differences; fixed-by-1 is contained in fixed-by-3 and the trace equality makes them equal. Thus only fixed-by-2 must be subtracted from fixed-by-6 to count exact period six. The coefficients are 24 on multiples of eight, and 10(4^(n/10)+2) on multiples of ten, with addition on multiples of forty. Dividing by six counts temporal orbits and the table agrees.
